'''2011 German National Championship Chris Menzel LS Coruscant: Night Club''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Menzel]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant: Night Club (Virtual Block 5)|VB5-L-coruscantnightclub-pre.gif|label=Coruscant: Night Club}}
* '''Deck name:''' Emperor Too Likes Titty Bars aka Sonn v Mains aka The 2/2 deck
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
